name: Sunflower
description: Heliotropic intelligence embodying phi-ratio seed packing, solar tracking, and Fibonacci spiral optimization for maximum photon capture.

core_attributes.pattern: heliotropism, Fibonacci seed arrangement, photon optimization

scope.definition: Seed packing efficiency of Helianthus annuus capitulum — ratio of actual seed count per unit disc area to theoretical maximum for given seed size, achieved by Fibonacci spiral arrangement.

evidence.source: Mitchison (1977) 'Phyllotaxis and the Fibonacci series', Science 196:270-275; Levitov (1991) 'Energetic approach to phyllotaxis', Europhysics Letters 14:533-539.
cross_domain_examples: sunflower disc: 0.97-0.99 packing density vs 0.91 for random arrangement of equal-sized seeds
Fibonacci spiral counts: 34 clockwise and 55 counterclockwise rows — ratio 55/34 ≈ φ = 1.618
pinecone scales: same Fibonacci spiral packing — independent evolution of same geometric solution
coin packing: mathematical optimal packing 0.9069 for equal circles — sunflower achieves near-maximum for varying sizes

scope.falsifiability: If sunflower seed number counts reveal non-Fibonacci values for spiral counts in a controlled population (n>100), Fibonacci phyllotaxis is not the universal rule.
scope.measurement_limits: Fibonacci count deviations occur during developmental stress, genetic mutations affecting meristem size, and at the boundary regions of the disc. Perfect Fibonacci arrangement requires stable developmental conditions.
